messages:
sara_pm: Quick async OKR check-in for the runtime-v3 milestone (canary -> full rollout). TL;DR: canary deployed yesterday, canary perf looks ok for 95p latency, but we hit a batching regression for small requests that makes p50 worse on some paths. full rollout slips ~1 week unless we merge a hotfix. :warning:

alex_eng: Got it. What actually shipped in canary (so PMs can update release notes)?

sara_pm: Canary shipped: runtime v3 image, autoscale policy tweak, and KV prefix cache enabled for session-mode. :ship:

jonas_lead: Noted the regression — failing under small-seq continuous batching. Repro steps: local load with seq_len=16 and bursty traffic -> p50 jumps. I've got a debug branch: `fix/batching-window` but tests fail on the last commit.

maria_se: I'll take the batching regression. Plan: 1) revert an aggressive micro-batching heuristic fallback, 2) add guard for tiny-seq path, 3) add unit test for seq_len <= 32. ETA EOD tomorrow. Assign me as owner. :handshake:

priya_staff: Heads up — the micro-batching heuristic relies on the newer NVIDIA driver that infra plans to roll next Tue. If we revert the heuristic, we should be able to decouple from the driver schedule.

alex_eng: Thanks @maria_se and @priya_staff. I'm pinging reviewers on the hotfix PRs: <https://git.company/repo/pull/482|PR#482> and <https://git.company/repo/pull/483|PR#483>. Can reviewers please prioritize (codeowners: @jonas_lead, @alex_eng, @maria_se). :eyes:

devops-bot: Canary deploy (runtime-v3) completed by deploy-bot at 1723420000. Health checks: 56/60 ok, 4 retries in batching-worker, auto-rollback disabled for canary tag.

jonas_lead: I'll review PR#482 now. If the failing test is flaky we can add an integration skip + followup, otherwise prefer to fix the root cause. Also recommending a canary hold + staged rollout to dedicated pools only.

maria_se: quick note — small snippet of the guard I'm proposing:

```
if (seq_len <= 32) {
  use_single_shard_path();
} else {
  use_micro_batching();
}
```

alex_eng: That looks good. After merge, we should run nightly perf job and a short chaos run against canary pool. I'll schedule the perf job.

sara_pm: Owners/next steps summary: 
- Maria -> own hotfix + tests (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Jonas -> review + approve or feedback (today)
- Alex -> run nightly perf + schedule chaos (after merge)
- Priya -> coordinate infra driver roll and confirm if revert is safe (today)

Please confirm by end of day so I can update OKR board (what slipped, new dates). Next async check-in Friday 16:00 PT. :calendar:

maria_se: Confirmed. Owning it. Will post CI links here when green.

jonas_lead: Reviewing now, aim to approve if tests look stable.

priya_staff: I'll confirm infra plan and post a short note before EOD. If infra rolls early we can opt for blue-green, else revert path is safest.

alex_eng: Will queue perf job and leave a post in the release-notes thread after we know final rollout date.

sara_pm: Thanks all — updating the milestone card: shipped = canary features, slipped = full rollout by ~1 week pending hotfix. Will ping again if anything changes. :+1:
